From a340a51ed801eab7bb454150c226323b865263cc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ruijie Li <ruijieli51@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 16:13:25 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] batman-adv: clear current gateway during teardown

batadv_gw_node_free() removes the gateway list entries during mesh teardown,
but it does not clear the currently selected gateway. This leaves stale
gateway state behind across cleanup and can break a later mesh recreation.

Clear bat_priv->gw.curr_gw before walking the gateway list so the selected
gateway reference is dropped as part of teardown.

Fixes: 2265c1410864 ("batman-adv: gateway election code refactoring")
Cc: stable@kernel.org
Reported-by: Yuan Tan <yuantan098@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Yifan Wu <yifanwucs@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Juefei Pu <tomapufckgml@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Xin Liu <bird@lzu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Ruijie Li <ruijieli51@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Zhanpeng Li <lzhanpeng2025@lzu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Ren Wei <n05ec@lzu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Sven Eckelmann <sven@narfation.org>

diff --git a/net/batman-adv/gateway_client.c b/net/batman-adv/gateway_client.c
index 51e9c081a2a4..a9d0346e8332 100644
--- a/net/batman-adv/gateway_client.c
+++ b/net/batman-adv/gateway_client.c
@@ -478,10 +478,14 @@ void batadv_gw_node_delete(struct batadv_priv *bat_priv,
  */
 void batadv_gw_node_free(struct batadv_priv *bat_priv)
 {
+	struct batadv_gw_node *curr_gw;
 	struct batadv_gw_node *gw_node;
 	struct hlist_node *node_tmp;
 
 	spin_lock_bh(&bat_priv->gw.list_lock);
+	curr_gw = rcu_replace_pointer(bat_priv->gw.curr_gw, NULL, true);
+	batadv_gw_node_put(curr_gw);
+
 	hlist_for_each_entry_safe(gw_node, node_tmp,
 				  &bat_priv->gw.gateway_list, list) {
 		hlist_del_init_rcu(&gw_node->list);
-- 
2.34.1

### Summary of Patch Modifications

#### File: `net/batman-adv/gateway_client.c`

The fix is made in the function `batadv_gw_node_free()`. Previously, during mesh teardown, this function removed all entries from the gateway list but did **not** clear the currently selected gateway (`bat_priv->gw.curr_gw`). This left a stale reference, which could break subsequent mesh recreation.

The modification adds two lines at the beginning of the function:
1. `curr_gw = rcu_replace_pointer(bat_priv->gw.curr_gw, NULL, true);`  
   This atomically replaces the current gateway pointer with `NULL` while preserving the RCU semantics.
2. `batadv_gw_node_put(curr_gw);`  
   This drops the reference to the previously selected gateway node, ensuring proper cleanup.

The rest of the function remains unchanged: it then proceeds to iterate and remove all entries from the gateway list.

#### Relationship Between Modifications

The change is self-contained within a single function and has a clear cause–effect relationship:
- **Before the fix**: `batadv_gw_node_free()` only cleaned the gateway list but left `curr_gw` pointing to a gateway node that had already been removed (or would be removed during list traversal). This dangling reference violated the expected cleanup sequence.
- **After the fix**: The currently selected gateway is explicitly cleared and its reference released **before** the list traversal. This ensures that no stale pointer remains, and any future recreation of the mesh starts with a clean gateway state.

The modification is minimal, impacting only the teardown logic, and resolves the reported bug without altering other parts of the gateway client code.

batman-adv: clear current gateway during teardown

batadv_gw_node_free() removes the gateway list entries during mesh teardown,
but it does not clear the currently selected gateway. This leaves stale
gateway state behind across cleanup and can break a later mesh recreation.

Clear bat_priv->gw.curr_gw before walking the gateway list so the selected
gateway reference is dropped as part of teardown.

Fixes: 2265c1410864 ("batman-adv: gateway election code refactoring")

Here is the root cause:
In the `batadv_gw_node_free()` function, the current gateway (`bat_priv->gw.curr_gw`) was not cleared or its reference dropped during mesh teardown, leaving stale gateway state that could break subsequent mesh recreation.

Here is the patch:
  */
 void batadv_gw_node_free(struct batadv_priv *bat_priv)
 {
+	struct batadv_gw_node *curr_gw;
 	struct batadv_gw_node *gw_node;
 	struct hlist_node *node_tmp;
 
 	spin_lock_bh(&bat_priv->gw.list_lock);
+	curr_gw = rcu_replace_pointer(bat_priv->gw.curr_gw, NULL, true);
+	batadv_gw_node_put(curr_gw);
+
 	hlist_for_each_entry_safe(gw_node, node_tmp,
 				  &bat_priv->gw.gateway_list, list) {
 		hlist_del_init_rcu(&gw_node->list);
 		batadv_gw_node_put(gw_node);
 		bat_priv->gw.generation++;
 	}
 	spin_unlock_bh(&bat_priv->gw.list_lock);
 }
